lines.japanese: 「やっぱここだろ」
lines.english: “Had to be here.”

lines.japanese: 「ですねー」
lines.english: “Naturally.”

lines.japanese: グローヴ通りを突きぬけるまでだらだらと続いた「夕食どこにするか会議」は、花水木通りに入ってすぐ、鳴の希望と俺の惰性とが一致してめでたく解決を迎えた。
lines.english: Our listless “where do we eat dinner?” summit dragged all the way down Grove Street. The moment we turned onto Flowering Dogwood Street, Naru’s preference and my own inertia aligned, and the matter reached its happy conclusion.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは開店したばかりのラーメン屋台を訪ねた。
lines.english: We made for the ramen cart, only just open for the night.

lines.japanese: 「メンマ」
lines.english: “Menma.”

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Yo.”

lines.japanese: 老け顔の大男は、火の具合を見ながら低い声で答えた。俺と鳴は前に来たときと同じく、テーブル席の端に向かい合わせで座った。
lines.english: The hulking man with the prematurely aged face answered in a low voice without taking his eye off the flame. As before, Naru and I sat facing each other at the end of one table.

lines.japanese: 「らっしゃい」
lines.english: “Welcome.”

lines.japanese: 「こんばんはー」
lines.english: “Good evening.”

lines.japanese: メンマはわざわざ火の元を離れて注文を取りにきた。俺ひとりのときより接客が丁寧だ。鳴はぺこりと頭を下げた。この前よりだいぶほぐれた笑い方だった。
lines.english: Menma actually left his stove to take our order. More attentive service than I ever got alone. Naru bobbed her head, wearing a much easier smile than last time.

lines.japanese: 「今日はどうする」
lines.english: “What'll it be today?”

lines.japanese: 「えーと、いつものふたつ」
lines.english: “Uh, two of the usual.”

lines.japanese: 目潰しピースを向けた。店主は「毎度」とつぶやいて、のしのし戻っていった。角張った頭に、角張った広い背中。俺はラーメンが届くまでのあいだ、あの大男をネタにして場を繋ごうと思った。
lines.english: I gave him an eye-gouging V-sign. The proprietor muttered, ‘Thanks,’ and lumbered back: square head, broad square back. Until the ramen arrived, I decided to keep things going at the big man's expense.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、あいつさ、角刈りのくせにシャンプーしたあとリンスすんだって。しかも角刈りのくせしてフルーティなやつだって」
lines.english: “You know, that guy uses conditioner after he shampoos. With a crew cut. Fruity conditioner, too.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、角刈りはフルーティ駄目ですかー」
lines.english: “Are crew cuts forbidden from being fruity?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だってあの頭、しっとりなめらか潤っちゃったら逆効果じゃん。ジンクピリチオンの無駄使いじゃん。つかマジで、どんな形してんのジンクピリチ──」
lines.english: “I mean, if that head gets all silky-smooth and moisturized, doesn't that defeat the point? What a waste of zinc pyrithione. Seriously, what shape is zinc pyrithi—”

lines.japanese: 「あらドラちゃあ～ん！　ワッツア～ップ？」
lines.english: “Well, look who it is—little Draaa! What's uuup?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: どすん、と鳴の隣りの丸椅子に、夜に溶けこんでいた黒い巨体が落ちてきた。
lines.english: A black bulk that had melted into the night dropped with a thump onto the stool beside Naru.

lines.japanese: 鳴は一回体をびくつかせたあと、目と口を丸くして、自分より高い位置にある異人の頭を見上げた。
lines.english: Naru gave one start, then tipped her perfectly round eyes and mouth up toward the foreigner looming over her.

lines.japanese: 「ドラちゃんったら、まーた今日も女の子と一緒なのね。新しいコレ？」
lines.english: “Dra, darling, another girl today? Is this the new *one?*”

lines.japanese: 本来小指を提示すべきところで、やつは欧米風のえげつない中指を立てた。下品な日米友好ジョークだ。俺はツッコミを入れなかった。
lines.english: Where a Japanese man would have held up his pinkie, Martinez gave us a viciously Western middle finger instead. It was a vulgar little joke on Japanese-American friendship. I let it pass without comment.

lines.japanese: 「っせーな。おまえ、この女いっぺん見てんだろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. You've seen her before.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、そーお？　会ったことあったかしら？」
lines.english: “Oh, have I? We've met?”

lines.japanese: やつは口の横に手の甲を添えて、ぎょろりと鳴を見下ろした。黒い顔から白い目玉が飛びだしそうだった。
lines.english: He held the back of one hand beside his mouth and rolled his eyes down at Naru. The whites looked ready to leap from his dark face.

lines.japanese: しかし鳴は、怯まずに愛想よく微笑みかえした。ちょっと意外だった。
lines.english: Naru, however, smiled pleasantly back without flinching. That surprised me a little.

lines.japanese: 度胸がついてきたのか、日本人以外とは相性がいいのか。あるいはもしかしたら、やつにもこの聖域の地形効果が及んでいるのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe she was getting braver. Maybe she just got on better with foreigners. Or perhaps the terrain bonus from this sanctuary extended to him too.

lines.japanese: 「こんばんはー。先日はどーもー」
lines.english: “Good evening. Nice to see you again.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、ほんとに？　ごめんなさいね。アタシ、外人の顔ってなかなか覚えられなくて──」
lines.english: “Oh, really? Forgive me. I have such trouble remembering foreign faces—”

lines.japanese: 外人は日本語でそんなことを言ったあと、天を仰ぎながら自国語でなにやらつぶやいた。
lines.english: Having said that in Japanese, the foreigner tipped his face toward heaven and muttered something in his native tongue.

lines.japanese: すると、さりげなく鳴が言葉を返した。たぶん同じ言語だ。すげえ。
lines.english: Naru answered him as casually as anything. Probably in the same language. Damn.

lines.japanese: マルチネスはちょっと驚いたあとで、長い溜息をつくようにべらべら俺の知らない言葉を吐きだしはじめた。合間合間に鳴が短いフレーズを挿んで会話を繋ぐ。
lines.english: After one startled beat, Martinez began spilling unfamiliar words in one long sigh. Naru threaded in a short phrase here and there to carry the conversation along.

lines.japanese: 「アイ、キャンノットスピーク、イングリッシュ。ファックユー」
lines.english: “I cannot speak English. Fuck you.”

lines.japanese: 取りのこされた俺は、上体を反らしながらコテコテの片仮名英語でつぶやいた。心安らぐ聖域が、いっとき俺の知らない文化圏に様変わりしたみたいだった。
lines.english: Left behind, I leaned away and muttered in the stiffest phonetic English imaginable. For a moment, my peaceful sanctuary had turned into a foreign world I knew nothing about.

lines.japanese: 昔、夜中のパン工場でバイトしたとき、同じ班の連中が地元高校の話題に休憩時間を丸々費やしていたことを思いだした。
lines.english: It took me back to a night job I'd once had at a bread factory, where the rest of my crew spent an entire break talking about their local high school.

lines.japanese: そうでなくてもアレは実際キツい仕事だった。ベルトコンベアに乗って休みなく進軍してくる、台湾バナナの一列縦隊……。
lines.english: And the job was brutal enough already. A single-file column of Taiwanese bananas, advancing without rest along the conveyor belt...

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いて屋台の方を見た。メンマは両腕をどっしり腰に置いて、湯の中で踊る麺を真剣なまなざしで観察していた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head and looked toward the cart. Menma stood with both hands planted firmly on his hips, gravely observing the noodles dance in the boiling water.

lines.japanese: 「ドラさーん？」
lines.english: “Dra?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 向きなおると鳴とマルチネスは、麺を観察するメンマを観察する俺を観察していた。
lines.english: I turned back. Naru and Martinez were watching me watch Menma watch the noodles.

lines.japanese: 「はー、なに見てるんですかー」
lines.english: “So, what are you looking at?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつに。ただの角刈り」
lines.english: “Nothing. Just a crew cut.”

lines.japanese: 「やあねえ、ひとりでギラついちゃって。アタシたちも雑ぜてちょうだいよ」
lines.english: “Oh, don't sit there getting all worked up by yourself. Let us in on it.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、見たきゃ勝手に見ろよ。おら、ご覧ください右手に見えますのがフルーティな角刈りだクソが」
lines.english: “Shut up. Look if you want. Ladies and gentlemen, visible on your right is one fruity crew cut. There, damn it.”

lines.japanese: 労働にいそしむラーメン屋に親指を向けた。おかげで俺はバナナ軍相手の激しい防衛戦と、その合間に訪れる孤独なブレイクタイムとを追体験する必要がなくなった。
lines.english: I thumbed toward the ramen man at work. Thanks to them, I no longer had to relive either the savage defensive war against the banana army or the lonely breaks between engagements.

lines.japanese: 「つーか、そっちこそ俺を雑ぜろ。わけ分かんねえ暗号ばっか使って、何の密談だコラ」
lines.english: “Actually, you two let *me* in. What's with all the code? What secret conference are you holding?”

lines.japanese: 勢いに乗ってそんなことまで言ってみた。売り言葉に買い言葉ってのは、意外と照れ屋な男の子には便利な風習だ。もしまたパン工場で働くことがあれば使えるかもしれない。
lines.english: Momentum carried me far enough to say it. Trading insult for insult was a surprisingly handy custom for a shy young man. It might serve me well if I ever worked in another bread factory.

lines.japanese: 「やー、ちょっとした恋の相談ですよー」
lines.english: “Oh, just a little advice about love.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　会ったばっかりでいきなりディープだな、おい」
lines.english: “Huh? That's awfully deep for two people who just met.”

lines.japanese: 「いえいえ全然ですよー。ドラさんを想う気持ちが日に日に募っていくんですけどどーしましょーっていう、ただそれだけの話ですからー」
lines.english: “Oh, hardly. I was merely asking what I ought to do about my feelings for Dra, which deepen with every passing day.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それだけっておまえ、ばか、本人の前でそんなハッキリ言うんじゃねーよ。ちょ、ちょっぴりもじもじしちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “M-merely? Idiot, don't say it so plainly in front of the man himself. You'll make me get a teensy bit bashful.”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫。この愛は国境さえ越えてみせるわ」
lines.english: “Don't you worry. Our love will cross any border.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえかよ」
lines.english: “You meant *you?*”

lines.japanese: 「いやん」
lines.english: “Oh, stop.”

lines.japanese: マルチネスを斜め下から睨みあげると、やつは大和撫子のように両手で黒い頬を挟んだ。
lines.english: I glared diagonally up at Martinez. He cradled his dark cheeks in both hands like a demure maiden of old Japan.

lines.japanese: 「つか、国境は越えられても性別は越えらんねーから」
lines.english: “Even if it can cross national borders, it can't cross the gender line.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ！　ぶら下げてるものが小さい男は心まで小さいのね！」
lines.english: “My! A man with a little thing dangling between his legs has a little heart to match!”

lines.japanese: 異国の大きな乙女は、どこかのクレープ屋に習ったような日本語で吠えた。
lines.english: The enormous maiden from foreign shores roared in Japanese that sounded suspiciously learned from a certain crêpe vendor.

lines.japanese: 「アホか。デカかろうが小っこかろうが、ぶら下げてる者同士じゃ法的にも倫理的にも不可能だっつーの」
lines.english: “Idiot. Big or small, if we've both got one dangling, this relationship is legally and morally impossible.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、いやな男！　百年の恋も冷めちゃったわ！」
lines.english: “Hmph! What a horrid man! There goes the love of a lifetime!”

lines.japanese: 「え、マジで。やっりー」
lines.english: “Seriously? Score!”

lines.japanese: 安堵に胸を撫でおろした俺は、やつの手を掴んでセンキューベリーマッチを二回唱えた。
lines.english: With a hand to my heart in relief, I seized his hand and said *thank you very much* twice.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと……なに。なんなのこのファッキンガイ。キッス・マイ・アスって感じなんだけど」
lines.english: “Wait... what? What the hell is with this fucking guy? He can kiss my ass.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラさん、レディに対して失礼ですよー」
lines.english: “Dra, that is no way to treat a lady.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、こいつレディっつうか、むしろダンディじゃん」
lines.english: “He's less lady than dandy.”

lines.japanese: 「なんですって！　Ｓｈｉｔ！　Ｄｉｃｋ　ｉｎ　ｙａ　ｍｏｕｔｈ！」
lines.english: “What did you say? Shit! Dick in ya mouth!”

lines.japanese: 突如オネエ言葉の黒人は豹変した。テーブルを叩いたり俺に指を突きつけたりしながら、早口の母国語で雄々しくがなりたてる。俺は意味の分からない騒音をかいくぐって、対面の女に顔を近づけた。
lines.english: One moment Martinez was speaking in that camp, feminine cadence; the next, he was a different man. Pounding the table and jabbing a finger at me, he roared away in rapid-fire English, suddenly all masculine swagger. Ducking through the meaningless barrage, I leaned toward the woman across from me.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。なんつってんの、こいつ」
lines.english: “Wait, what? What's he saying?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、まー、端的に申しますと罵詈雑言です」
lines.english: “In brief, he is heaping abuse upon you.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ端的にって。もったいぶんねーで具体的に訳せよ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘in brief’? Quit playing coy and translate the details.”

lines.japanese: 「やー、すみません。あまりに卑俗な表現のため、うら若き乙女の口からはとてもとても」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sorry. The language is so terribly vulgar that a tender young maiden could never, ever repeat it.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　誰が乙女だコラ。いまさら夢みたいなこと言ってねーで、さっさと訳せ大食い女」
lines.english: “Huh? Who's a maiden? Don't start living in a fantasy now. Translate, you bottomless pit.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ黙れ。ぶっ殺すぞ、このしみったれた黄色いサルめ」
lines.english: “Shut your mouth or I'll kill you, you miserable yellow monkey.”

lines.japanese: 「……なんだとこの糞ガキ」
lines.english: “...What did you call me, you little shit?”

lines.japanese: 「わ、私じゃないですよう！　こちらの方が！」
lines.english: “N-not me! This gentleman!”

lines.japanese: 「え……ああ、そうか。悪りぃ、続けて」
lines.english: “Oh... right. Sorry. Keep going.”

lines.japanese: 「え、続けるんですか」
lines.english: “You want me to keep going?”

lines.japanese: 「嫌そうな顔すんなよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。ブッＫＩＬＬすぞＴＨＩＳヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don’t make that face. I’ll fucking kill you, asshole. I’ll KILL you, THIS bastard.”

lines.japanese: 「えー……雌犬の息子よ、私はあなたの口をとても大きな性器で塞ぎたいと思う」
lines.english: “Um... Son of a female dog, I wish to obstruct your mouth with an extremely large sexual organ.”

lines.japanese: 「やる気ねーなおまえ、ソレめっさ直訳じゃねーの。ちっとは意訳しろよ」
lines.english: “You're not even trying. That's the most painfully literal translation I've ever heard. Translate the meaning, not every word.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。それでは、えー……薄汚ねえウジ虫め、おまえのブラックホールはさながらこの世の森羅万象すべてを呑みつくす地獄の門だな」
lines.english: “Very well. Then... You filthy maggot, your black hole is a gate of Hell that would swallow all creation under heaven.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、こんど意訳しすぎだろ。いまこの外人、ひと言『アス』しか言ってないんだけど」
lines.english: “Now you've gone way too far the other way. Martinez said exactly one word: ‘ass.’”

lines.japanese: 「まったく、こんな利発で聡明そうな美少女を連れやがって。身にあまる光栄に感謝するこったな、げへえ」
lines.english: “How dare you bring along such an intelligent, brilliant young beauty? Give thanks for an honor far beyond your station. Heh-heh-heh.”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、もうこいつ、すでに喋ってないんだけど」
lines.english: “Actually, he stopped talking a while ago.”

lines.japanese: 「目は口ほどにものを言いますよー」
lines.english: “Eyes can say as much as any mouth.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえよ、おま、適当なこと言ってんじゃ──うわ、マジだ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't just make shit u—whoa, you're right.”

lines.japanese: 気が付けば、マルチネスはげへえと言いたげな目でほくそ笑んでいた。
lines.english: Sure enough, Martinez was smirking with eyes that practically said *heh-heh-heh.*

lines.japanese: 「グッチョイス、ドラ」
lines.english: “Good choice, Dra.”

lines.japanese: そしてニッカリと白い歯を剥きだすピースフルな外人スマイルを残して、やつは夜の街へ消えていった。
lines.english: Then, baring a brilliant row of white teeth in one last great peace-and-love grin, he vanished into the night.

lines.japanese: 「んだありゃ……おいオヤジ、ラーメン遅せえよ」
lines.english: “What the hell was that...? Hey, old man, where's our ramen?”

lines.japanese: 湯気の立つ丼をふたつ運んできた店主に、俺はあからさまな八つ当たりをした。
lines.english: I shamelessly took my frustration out on the proprietor as he brought over two steaming bowls.

lines.japanese: 「お待ちどう。ゆっくりしてきな」
lines.english: “Sorry to keep you. Take your time.”

lines.japanese: メンマは俺を無視して鳴にだけ声を残していった。
lines.english: Menma ignored me and addressed the parting words to Naru alone.

lines.japanese: 上等だ。たっぷりお言葉に甘えてやる。
lines.english: Fine by me. I’d take him up on that and then some.
